title: Verify and close the M0 milestone
description: Run the complete local and remote acceptance gate, synchronize public issue state, and leave the repository clean without publishing npm artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Local checks pass, remote main CI is green, GitHub mirrors Beads, the Suite is installed and verified, no npm release exists, and the working tree is clean.

title: Enforce deterministic CI and public-safety checks
description: Add GitHub Actions, generated-output checks, package allowlist checks, public-data safety checks, and grouped dependency updates.
acceptance_criteria: The main and pull-request workflows run the complete check suite on Linux x64 with pinned actions and a checksum-verified Pi 0.83.0 artifact.
close_reason: GitHub Actions run 30638920051 passed the pinned, checksum-verified, disconnected verification job.

title: Install and verify the local Suite in Pi
description: After repository verification succeeds, install the local aggregate through the Pi host while preserving existing user settings and retaining a rollback path.
acceptance_criteria: Pi lists the local package and starts it offline without a model or session; any failed verification restores the original settings.
close_reason: Pi installed the local Aggregate Package, preserved existing settings, passed offline RPC startup, and left auth, model-store, and session state unchanged.

title: Generate the ordered aggregate composition
description: Implement the explicit ordered Suite registry and deterministic generator for the aggregate entry point and bundled dependency metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Generated artifacts are deterministic, fail-fast composition is preserved, and CI can detect any generated-file drift.
close_reason: Ordered Suite registry and deterministic aggregate generator pass drift and bundling contract tests.

title: Certify source and tarball loading with Pi 0.83.0
description: Build no-model smoke verification for a fixture, generated aggregate, and isolated package tarball using the certified standalone Pi host.
acceptance_criteria: RPC smoke checks run without prompts, credentials, sessions, context discovery, or network access and detect extension loading failures.
close_reason: Standalone Pi RPC tests certify fixture, generated Aggregate, source Package, and extracted tarball loading without model calls.

title: Initialize repository governance and Beads
description: Create the public repository, configure local-authoritative Beads with a GitHub mirror, and establish repository governance without credentials or private paths.
acceptance_criteria: The public repository exists, Beads is local-only with tracked JSONL, GitHub sync is push-only, and repository governance settings are documented.
close_reason: Public repository, local-only Beads configuration, GitHub mirror, and governance contract established.

title: Scaffold the Bun workspace and aggregate package
description: Create the private Bun workspace and the source-only @jczhang02/pi-stuff aggregate package with exact tooling and Pi 0.83.0 development pins.
acceptance_criteria: Frozen installation succeeds with Bun 1.3.14, strict type checking is configured, and the aggregate package is packable without product behavior.
close_reason: Bun workspace, strict TypeScript configuration, Changesets, and source-only aggregate package verified.

title: M0: establish the engineering foundation
description: Establish a public, deterministic engineering foundation for the native Pi Stuff Suite without shipping product behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The repository, package contract, tests, CI, issue mirror, and local installation all satisfy the agreed M0 completion gate.

title: Document the Suite domain and contributor contract
description: Create the repository instructions, domain glossary, architectural decision, tracker contract, contribution policy, security policy, and public project documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Engineering instructions are repository-scoped, domain terminology is canonical, the plugin boundary is explicit, and no engineering document becomes a Pi runtime resource.
close_reason: Repository instructions, domain glossary, ADR, tracker policy, contribution guide, and security documentation completed.
